reason: Four defects in the provider-chat goal family. (2) ChatGoal.progress_is_coherent raised 'current goal step exceeds the plan' once a goal had taken more turns than its plan had lines, but _persist_turn_inputs increments current_step on every goal turn and the dispatch gate bounds it by step_budget, not the plan; a two-line plan with a step budget of eight therefore failed the third send with a raw 422 inside _persist_turn_inputs, persisted nothing, and left the goal RUNNING so every later send failed identically. current_step now counts turns (the plan is guidance), so the goal runs until its step, token or time budget pauses it cleanly. (3) ChatService._charge_goal wrote status PAUSED whenever accumulated usage crossed token_budget with no check of the current status, so a goal cancelled or completed while a response was in flight came back as PAUSED (with completed_at still set) and could be resumed; usage is still always recorded but only a RUNNING goal transitions. (18) ChatGoalService.write ran _propagate_parent_stop before and outside the parent's guarded update and paused every non-terminal child including DRAFT ones, which then resumed to RUNNING without ever passing Start; now children are read first, the parent update and the child updates run in one store transaction (a revision conflict rolls everything back), and pause skips drafts while cancel still retires them. (20) GoalCreate.child_budget had no upper bound while ChatGoal.child_session_ids caps at 32, so the 33rd start_child failed validation after its child session and goal were already committed; a shared CHAT_GOAL_CHILD_LIMIT now bounds child_budget (le=32) and reserve_child refuses when the list is already full, before anything is created. tests/v3/test_chat_goals.py gains four tests that each fail on main: test_goal_turns_continue_past_a_plan_shorter_than_the_step_budget (four turns under a two-line plan, then the step budget pauses the goal), test_charging_a_terminal_goal_records_usage_without_resurrecting_it (cancelled and completed stay put, running still pauses), test_parent_pause_skips_draft_children_and_commits_with_the_parent (draft untouched, started child paused, a lost parent revision race changes nothing), and test_child_budget_is_bounded_by_the_child_list_cap (33 refused at GoalCreate, full list refused before any create). test_paused_wall_time_does_not_consume_active_goal_budget's fake clock is trimmed to one read per action because a pause now stamps the parent and its children with the same instant. tests/v3/test_chat.py, test_chat_tool_loop.py and test_chat_schedules.py are selected as regression coverage for the changed ChatGoal validator and _charge_goal callers along every goal-charging path (turn completion, routing steps, compaction, context recovery, schedule-fired goal turns).
exclusions: No frontend tests: no ui/ change. No native tests: no Tauri or Rust change. No Playwright: src/nebula/v3/chat.py matches area:assistant, area:chat-edit-in-place and area:provider-thinking and domain.py/chat.py match area:core-api, but those browser journeys run against a mock runtime or a stub provider with no conversation goal, and the only chat.py change is a status guard inside _charge_goal that is reached solely on goal turns; the Python tests drive every changed path directly. No full suites.
